verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.github.com, which hosts GitHub's documentation, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for the platform GitHub Mobile belongs to. The file is GitHub-wide, though, and the evidence doesn't show how much it covers the mobile app specifically. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers GitHub Mobile content specifically, further agent-oriented docs beyond the index file, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
